5: struct ringbuf {
6:     uint8_t *buf;
7:     size_t capacity;
8:     size_t head;   /* next write position */
9:     size_t tail;   /* next read position */
10:     size_t count;  /* bytes currently stored */
11: };
12: 
13: ringbuf_t *rb_create(size_t capacity)
14: {
15:     ringbuf_t *rb = NULL;
16: 
17:     if (capacity == 0)
18:         return NULL;
19: 
20:     rb = malloc(sizeof(*rb));
21:     if (!rb)
22:         return NULL;
23: 
24:     rb->buf = malloc(capacity);
25:     if (!rb->buf) {
26:         free(rb);
27:         return NULL;
28:     }
29: 
30:     rb->capacity = capacity;
31:     rb->head = 0;
32:     rb->tail = 0;
33:     rb->count = 0;
34:     return rb;
35: }
36: 
37: void rb_destroy(ringbuf_t *rb)
38: {
39:     if (!rb)
40:         return;
41:     free(rb->buf);
42:     free(rb);
43: }

45: size_t rb_write(ringbuf_t *rb, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
46: {
47:     size_t written = 0;
48: 
49:     if (!rb || !data || len == 0)
50:         return 0;
51: 
52:     /* How much free space do we have? */
53:     if (rb->count == rb->capacity)
54:         return 0;
55: 
56:     /* Space available = capacity - count */
57:     size_t avail = rb->capacity - rb->count;
58:     if (len > avail)
59:         len = avail;
60: 
61:     written = len;
62: 
63:     /* First segment: from head to end of buffer */
64:     size_t first = rb->capacity - rb->head;
65: 
66:     if (first >= len) {
67:         memcpy(rb->buf + rb->head, data, len);
68:         rb->head = (rb->head + len) % rb->capacity;
69:     } else {
70:         memcpy(rb->buf + rb->head, data, first);
71:         memcpy(rb->buf, data + first, len - first);
72:         rb->head = (rb->head + len) % rb->capacity;
73:     }
74: 
75:     rb->count += len;
76:     return written;
77: }
